title: Get Purchase Order Details
description: Operates on Purchase Orders. In the Zuper client app this module is labeled "Purchase Order" for most companies, and "Material Order" for companies in the roofing industry — the API and data shape are identical either way. Purchase Orders and Work Orders (Service Orders) share the exact same underlying schema and endpoints; they're distinguished only by the `purchase_order_type` field (`PURCHASE_ORDER` here) and the `/purchase_orders` vs `/service_orders` route prefix. A UID belonging to the other module (e.g. a Work Order UID fetched via `/purchase_orders/:uid`) returns 404.
